message.content:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: emojivoto
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: emoji-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: emoji-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: emoji-svc
  ports:
    - name: grpc
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: emoji-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: emoji-svc
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: emoji-svc
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: emoji-svc
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: emoji-svc
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-emoji-svc:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: GRPC_PORT
              value: "8080"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: voting-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: voting-svc
spec:
  selector:
    app: voting-svc
  ports:
    - name: grpc
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: voting-svc
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: voting-svc
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: voting-svc
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: voting-svc
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: voting-svc
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-voting-svc:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: GRPC_PORT
              value: "8080"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
  type: LoadBalancer   # change to NodePort if LoadBalancer not available
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-web:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          env:
            - name: WEB_PORT
              value: "8080"
            - name: EMOJISVC_HOST
              value: "emoji-svc:8080"
            - name: VOTINGSVC_HOST
              value: "voting-svc:8080"
            - name: INDEX_BUNDLE
              value: "dist/index_bundle.js"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: vote-bot
  namespace: emojivoto
  labels:
    app: vote-bot
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: vote-bot
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: vote-bot
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: vote-bot
          image: buoyantio/emojivoto-web:v11
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["emojivoto-vote-bot"]
          env:
            - name: WEB_HOST
              value: "web:8080"
```
